### When You Are the Offender, Part 1
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-april-10-2023.html
Passage: Matthew 5:23-24
Points:
- Lingering offenses against others disrupt our prayers and worship before God.
- When convicted of having wronged someone, we must pause rather than ignoring the prompting.
- Jesus commands a four-step process: stop, go, be reconciled, and return.
- Peacemaking requires the offender to initiate action by confessing the wrong and seeking forgiveness.

### The Scope of the Sixth Commandment
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-scope-of-the-sixth-commandment
Passage: Matthew 5:21-26
Points:
- Jesus reveals the spiritual depth of the law against murder rather than abolishing it.
- Merely refraining from physical violence does not fulfill God's command.
- Unjust anger and harboring hatred break the commandment at the heart level.
- Christians must ask the Holy Spirit for help to abandon bitterness and pursue forgiveness.
